text: Local residents have requested that the speed limit be reduced on Deloraine Avenue and Old Orchard Grove as both streets abut the Old Orchard Grove Playground which was recently revitalized and is one of the most used playgrounds in Ward 16. We want to ensure that vehicles slow down in front of the park and in this residential neighbourhood where most local children come to play. I am requesting a speed limit reduction to 30km/hr on Deloraine Avenue between Avenue Road to Bathurst Street and on Old Orchard Grove from Avenue Road to Ledbury Street.

North York Community Council: 1. Reduced speed limit from 50km/hr to 30km/hr on Deloraine Avenue from Avenue Road to Ledbury Street. 2. Reduced speed limit from 50km/hr to 30km/hr on Old Orchard Grove from Avenue Road to Ledbury Street.
